description: Public launch-page images. Some are app UI captures, some are model-output renders derived from data whose owner authorized public derivative publication, and some contain third-party UI or marks for nominative comparison. Raw DICOM is excluded. These images are not relicensed under the wrapper's Apache-2.0 license.

feature-setup.png.scope: First-party application UI capture with no patient data.

feature-sample.png.scope: First-party application UI capture using the bundled non-clinical sample.

benchmark-totalseg.png.scope: Model-output render derived from owner-authorized CT data; raw DICOM excluded.

benchmark-dentalseg.png.scope: Model-output render derived from owner-authorized CT data; raw DICOM excluded.

benchmark-toothseg.png.scope: Model-output render derived from owner-authorized CT data; raw DICOM excluded.

benchmark-slicer.png.scope: Benchmark screenshot containing 3D Slicer UI and marks for nominative comparison; third-party UI and marks are not relicensed.

old-article-thumbnail.png.scope: Thumbnail of the project owner's 2024 article; embedded third-party UI and marks are not relicensed.
